requirements.requirement: There is a target research paper whose writing date falls between 2012 and 2022.
The target research paper was written by exactly two people.
One of the authors of the target research paper has another research paper in the Journal of Baltic Science Education whose writing date falls between 2016 and 2023.
One of the authors of the target research paper was academic staff of Harran University as of 2023.
The target research paper contains exactly six tables in total.
In one of the tables of the target research paper, one of the emotions has a value of 13.53 percent.
The name of the target research paper that satisfies the stated conditions is to be identified.
